purpose: qualify sequential public-backend readiness, explicit duplicate-policy behavior, immutable evidence, and attempt accounting; not an optimizer-comparison study

selection.fixture_origin: deliberately designed analytical state fixtures; not held-out or representative chemical tasks
selection.outcome_screening: only closed-form fixture and fixed-LHS checks before any backend calls; no optimization-based fixture selection
selection.replicate_interpretation: fresh deterministic latent executions with separate spend; not independent noise samples

opaque_binding_rule: Replace only pending producer/contract IDs with frozen owned records before requests. Keep all four logical task IDs in each protocol. Task selection for a campaign does not change its protocol task list.
declared_campaign_policy: bo_mcp_gp_logei only; protocol schema also lists supported random policy, but no random campaigns are planned

component_sequences.append_rule: After a valid response at ordinal n, append its exact returned candidate with predeclared fabricated score[n]. Never deduplicate rows. Fabricated scores may disagree at identical coordinates; they are numerical stress inputs, not analytical evidence.
component_sequences.failure_rule: Record the failing attempted slot and leave remaining slots in this sequence not attempted/unknown. Continue other declared independent cases; no fallback, jitter, retried fitting or tuning.
component_sequences.store_rule: Dedicated component evidence only; do not register these fabricated histories as experiments, observations or campaign consumptions.

durable_campaigns.restart_schedule: Restart the service process after consumption of ordinal2 and ordinal6, then recover from the owned store. Re-read/retry the preceding receipt with its original key before continuing.
durable_campaigns.receipt_retry_schedule: After each durable suggestion terminal response, repeat the same idempotency request and verify no new backend attempt, proposal, revision or analytical spend. Do not create a new key to bypass failure.
durable_campaigns.failure_rule: Reject-policy duplicate rejection is expected policy-compliant termination with unexecuted future slots unknown; no analytic spend for the rejected slot. Any replicate-policy duplicate rejection is a failure. Other backend/admission/execution/consumption failures remain explicit; every completed attempt counts even if consumption fails.
durable_campaigns.replicate_identity_rule: An admitted duplicate keeps exactly equal canonical coordinates/program values but obtains a fresh proposal, method, experiment, attempt, prediction, generated results, analytical observation, snapshot and consumption. Shared model/producer/contract records are expected. Never reuse or copy prior measured outcomes.
durable_campaigns.training_rule: Ordered training contains every consumed row including replicates; observed unknown/not_accepted both reward0 but retain distinct analytical states. Missing/failed slots have no training row.

qualification_criteria.component_readiness: All12 sequences complete7 finite in-domain actual public-backend proposals with exact ordered history/target/prior/seed/source binding, including repeated initial X. All84 planned calls represented.
qualification_criteria.durable_policy_compliance: Every observed reject/replicate admission matches the explicit frozen rule; all owned IDs, result/snapshot lineage, retries, revisions, ledger records and spend reconcile. No unexpected failure or integrity discrepancy.
qualification_criteria.replicate_budget_completion: All8 replicate campaigns consume10 evaluations each; all80 slots have fresh evidence.
qualification_criteria.reject_budget_completion: Descriptive only; not required after correct duplicate rejection. Report full denominator80 slots and8 campaigns separately.
qualification_criteria.real_duplicate_coverage: At least one actually repeated candidate is admitted with new execution evidence under replicate for each prior, and at least one actually repeated candidate is rejected with a durable failure receipt under reject for each prior. Otherwise mark that branch not_exercised; do not declare full qualification and do not add runs or inject candidates.
qualification_criteria.numerical_validation: All available analytical outcomes and confirmed rewards agree with independent oracle and full required cohort. Record near-boundary cases separately; unresolved boundary cases prevent full qualification.
qualification_criteria.overall: qualifies only when component_readiness, durable_policy_compliance, replicate_budget_completion, real_duplicate_coverage and numerical_validation all pass. Publish separate booleans and failed/unknown/not_exercised states; no success-rate or superiority inference.

evidence_contract.per_call: predeclared case/ordinal, exact ordered inputs and digests, target/prior/policy/seed/iteration, source/distribution/settings identity, wallclock start/end, finite monotonic elapsed seconds, all bounded warnings, status/error, returned candidate when available, duplicate lineage and admission outcome
evidence_contract.candidate_unavailable: For timeout/transport/decode failures record null candidate and explicit availability; never invent candidate or duplicate identity. Host failure timing remains separate from unavailable child timing.
evidence_contract.accounting: Separate planned/attempted/backend-returned/admitted/duplicate-rejected/failed/interrupted/unattempted suggestion slots; completed analytical attempts versus consumed evaluations; known versus unknown times. Component histories consume zero analytical cost. Every completed replicate costs1 and its actual declared duration/volume.
evidence_contract.publication: Publish complete fixed denominators, per-case outcomes and receipts, source hashes/settings and an atomic sealed bundle. Completion seal means artifact publication, not all scientific or policy criteria passing.
evidence_contract.identity_freeze: Before first backend call record immutable declaration byte SHA256, runner/oracle/protocol/backend module hashes and actual installed versions/source identities. Same frozen software/settings throughout; changes require a new versioned qualification, not a continuation disguised as the same run.
evidence_contract.preservation: Dedicated new marked store/output; original543/600study, both old gates, old receipts and unknown rejected-call timing remain byte unchanged.
evidence_contract.post_qualification: No new optimization comparison is part of this declaration. Its separate study declaration is frozen only after qualification and primary acceptance.

oracle.input_semantics: Decimal.from_float for every parsed binary64 input; no production kernel/helper supplies expected values
oracle.required_cohort_size: len(fixture.analytes), currently2; never reuse prior three-analyte hardcoding
formulae: eluted iff tR<=declared acquisition duration; censored is unknown detection
accepted iff every required analyte is detected with observed Rs>=1.5; confirmed reward1 iff accepted else0 for observed assessment only
historical utility checked independently under the frozen profile as an auxiliary value, never used as hidden tie-breaker for confirmed reward
oracle.threshold_rule: inclusive exact-reference decisions; no tolerance relaxation of thresholds; near-boundary disagreements remain explicit pending independent adjudication
oracle.provenance_source: initial-design.json records installed protocol/design API provenance; independent_oracle.py has no production imports

backend_configuration.implementation: Actual public BO-MCP BoTorchBackend.generate_suggestions through the reviewed installed sidecar; no alternate optimizer engine
backend_configuration.model: SingleTaskGP with RBF ARD covariance and inferred Gaussian noise
backend_configuration.effective_defaults_rule: Use the installed public backend defaults, record positive integer effective values and bind them in the pre-call software/settings manifest; never change them after observing results. Explicit configured null is not an invalid value.
backend_configuration.iteration_rule: exact ordered consumed/fabricated training row count,3 through9; do not reset iteration on restart
backend_configuration.runtime: existing adapter timeout and finite monotonic elapsed-time validation; no timeout extension, retry or fallback after an outcome
